key_insight: DepGPO improves reinforcement learning for terminal agents by assigning credit only along execution dependencies between commands, rather than to unrelated steps.
engineering_relevance: This is useful for coding and debugging agents because it can make training more stable and more aligned with the commands that truly affect the final outcome.
method: Build a command dependency graph from execution traces.
Trace backward from resources inspected by the task verifier to identify relevant reads and writes.
Redistribute trajectory advantages using dependency-aware credit signals across steps.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive comparative experiments and ablation studies showing better task performance and training stability on complex terminal tasks.
watch_item: Dependency graphs depend on accurate execution traces and verifier-visible resources, so errors or incomplete observability could weaken credit assignment.
paper_title: Credit Where It Matters: Dependency-Aware Policy Optimization for Terminal Agents
